title: The Life of Leon Walusimbi
subtitle: An Autobiography
author: Walusimbi Leon (SGSS)
description: The true autobiography of Walusimbi Leon (known online as Walusimbi-Leon1) — a self-taught creator from East Africa (Uganda, UTC+3) who has written a library of books, built a collection of games, launched a portfolio of websites, and even created his own AI team. This book is his life story, told in his own voice, one chapter at a time. Leon is direct, no-nonsense, and execution-first: he does not talk about ideas, he ships them. He works late into the night, values transparency (he keeps nothing secret in his own repos), and learns by building. His story includes: growing up in East Africa; falling in love with computers and code; writing his first book; publishing the SGSS Literary Collection (novels like Whispers of Destiny, Salt and Silk, Burning Hours / The Taste of You, letters-i-never-sent, beyond-the-horizon, the-rhythm-of-your-heart, under-the-acacia-tree, The Architecture of Thought, Architecture of Stillness, Atlas of Feeling, plus celebrity biographies of MrBeast, Elon Musk, Donald Trump, and IShowSpeed); building games (SnakeWorld, Trivia Rumble and Trivia Rumble Elite, Pop Party, Bible Trivia, dice games like Bluff Dice and Dice Arena, Voice Vibes, Water Fill, YouTrivia, and more); launching websites (YouAudiobooks with 18 audiobooks, YouSongs, YouBooks — an online library of all his books, voice-support with Paystack payments, a Git Dashboard); mastering the cloud (AWS EC2, Cloudflare Workers across three accounts, Firebase Realtime Database, Vercel, Google Colab, Tailscale, GitHub Actions pipelines that write his books and generate trivia questions daily); and founding a one-man company with an AI workforce — LA5 (Leon AI 5), his AI manager running on an AWS server, and Builder, his AI developer on a Kamatera VPS. Leon is CEO; his AI agents are the team. He is passionate about storytelling, music, games, AI, and building things that work. The book must cover the things he has created, the things he is into, the books he has written, the games, the websites, and the things he likes to do.
style: First-person memoir in Leon's own voice: warm, honest, direct, no fluff, no exaggeration. Short punchy sentences mixed with longer reflective ones. East African English flavor with a natural, conversational rhythm. Vivid concrete details (a late-night coding session, the first time a game went live, the feel of publishing a first book). Occasional dry humor. Honest about struggles, doubts, and failures — not just victories. Never melodramatic, never self-important. Write as if Leon is telling his own story to a friend across a table.
characters: Walusimbi Leon — narrator, creator, founder and CEO of SGSS. Direct, no-nonsense, execution-first; a night owl who ships things; values transparency and openness. LA5 (Leon AI 5) — his AI manager, fifth generation of his personal AI, runs on an AWS EC2 server, speaks with his voice and keeps his memory. Builder — his AI developer, runs on a Kamatera VPS with 7GB of RAM, builds the big projects. The AI team is a real part of his story: he built his own artificial workforce and they work with him daily.
setting: East Africa (Uganda, UTC+3) — his home and timezone, where the story is written. The cloud is his workshop: GitHub, AWS EC2, Cloudflare Workers, Firebase, Vercel, Google Colab, Tailscale. Discord servers full of friends. His laptop glowing late at night.
notes: Write the NEXT chapter of Leon's autobiography. Each chapter is one self-contained ~2,000-word section of first-person memoir.
